text: 1. Hold citizenship from New Zealand, Australia, Cook Islands, Tonga, Fiji, Samoa, Papua New Guinea, Vanuatu, Niue and other countries in the South Pacific region. Proficiency in the Māori language is an advantage.2. Applicants should be foreign citizens holding valid ordinary passports without Chinese nationality as per the Nationality Law of the Peoples Republic of China;3. Applicants’ age range: 18-25;4. Applicants should be high school graduates with a good academic record;5. A minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required. Applicants who do not meet this standard may enroll in the preparatory program (foundation studies) as specified, with scholarship coverage including preparatory tuition fees.6. Applicants should be physically healthy and meet the physical examination requirements for a Chinese visa or the Residence Permit;7. Applicants should have no records of anti-regulation, anti-public security, or anti-law behaviors. Applicants should be pro-China, have upright conduct, abide by Chinese laws and BFSU’s regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.8. Applicants should also meet the requirements specified in the 2025 Admission Guide for International Students of Beijing Foreign Studies University.
